stem:
Which key idea is suggested by this sentence?

When people think of exercise, they probably envision someone muscular lifting hundreds of pounds on a barbell or swift and strong sprinters speeding along a racetrack.

options.label: A
options.text: Most exercise routines require an advanced level of skill.

options.label: B
options.text: Proper equipment is often needed for certain exercise programs.

options.label: C
options.text: Anyone can take part in exercise with the right amount of training.

options.label: D
options.text: People avoid exercise because they think it is beyond their capabilities.

visual_elements: When people think of exercise, they probably envision someone muscular lifting hundreds of pounds on a barbell or swift and strong sprinters speeding along a racetrack.
